verdict.rationale: Linear's homepage claims incoming conversations and feedback are automatically turned into issues that are routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team. The changelog says Linear Agent can act on newly reported issues and that teams can triage in Linear. This is direct but marketing-level support: the triage and prioritization mechanism is not documented in depth, and the event-driven agent evidence covers investigating and fixing issues rather than triage. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how AI assigns priority, labels and teams to incoming bugs; configuration and controls for automatic triage; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks

citations.quote: Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
When a new issue is reported, Linear Agent can investigate and attempt a fix before it reaches an engineer, reducing the load on your team.
You can triage, plan, review, and ship—all in Linear.
Describe the job in plain language and then choose whether it should run on a schedule or in response to an event.
